status: llull's own synthetic fixture. Every dimension below is a SYNTHETIC benchmark value chosen for repeatability, not a catalogue value (real pipe / flange / bolt dimensions are owned by 01-piping-specs-catalog). Expected counts and distances are closed forms computed by derive_vis_expected.py; frame times are TBD - measure.

layout.axis: bays along +X, pitch 6000 mm; bay i spans x = 6000 i .. 6000 (i + 1)
layout.columns: 2 per bay at x = 6000 i, y = -3000 and +3000, base z = 0, height 6000
layout.beam: 1 per bay at x = 6000 i, spanning y -3000..3000 at z = 6000
layout.pipes: 8 per bay along +X on top of the beam, y = -2100 + 600 j (j = 0..7); j = 0..3 DN100 (OD 114.3), j = 4..7 DN200 (OD 219.1)
layout.flangedJoint: per pipe per bay at x = 6000 i + 300: 2 flanges, 8 studs, 16 nuts
layout.shoe: 1 per pipe per bay on the beam, at x = 6000 i
layout.valve: 1 per pipe in every bay with i mod 4 = 3, at x = 6000 i + 4500

services.rule: pipe j carries service services[j]; colour is resolved by the active colour profile (ASME A13.1 categories, data/service_colour_schemes.json) and is a PER-INSTANCE attribute, so it never splits a batch

labels: smoke (~2e3; n = 8 so the every-4th-bay valve array has count >= 2)

batching.rule: R-BATCH-v1: one InstancedMesh per (prototype, LOD0) and per (prototype, LOD1) bucket that is non-empty after culling; LOD2 is a unit box scaled per instance to the prototype bbox, one InstancedMesh per material class; colour, selection tint and highlight are per-instance attributes; unique (non-repeated) geometry goes to one BatchedMesh per material class
batching.derivation: 2 x 13 (LOD0 + LOD1 buckets) + 4 (LOD2 box per material class) + 0 (no unique geometry in SYN-RACK) = 30, independent of n
batching.excluded: background / environment, grid, gizmos, edges overlay, shadow passes, selection outline post-pass (each budgeted separately in TECHNICAL_SPEC section 8)

lod.metric: projected bbox diagonal in pixels p = D H / (2 d tan(fov / 2)), d = camera-to-instance-centre distance (camera.zoom = 1)
lod.thresholdSource: named defaults `lod:llull-v1` (llull choice); cull at 1 px mirrors the Navisworks default area culling of objects smaller than 1 x 1 pixel (S16)
lod.hysteresisSemantics: three r186 LOD.update (T4): a visible level i stays until d < distance_i (1 - hysteresis)

gpuMemory.note: per-instance cost only; geometry of the 13 prototypes x 3 LODs is negligible. the 2000-px matrices texture at 1e6 instances must be checked against gl.MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE of the target GPU at start-up (the renderer splits a batch whose texture side would exceed it; VIS_GPU_LIMIT warning).

frameTime.procedure: tests/perf/plantViewport.perf.ts (Playwright, Chromium, --enable-gpu, fixed 1920x1080 window, devicePixelRatio 1): load SYN-RACK-v1 at each size from a saved .llull file; wait for first frame; orbit the camera 360 deg about the rack centre in 600 frames with frameloop 'always'; record renderer.info.render.calls and triangles at frames 0, 300, 599 and the median / p95 frame time from requestAnimationFrame deltas; repeat 3 runs, keep the median of medians; store per-machine baseline JSON (GPU string from WEBGL_debug_renderer_info) and fail on +20 % regression (QUALITY_GATES proposed gate 2).

targetsProposed.basis: 60 Hz / 30 Hz frame budgets (1000/60, 1000/30 ms) - targets, not measured values
